value.rationale: A natural maximal-shortest-path hitting problem on classic regular bipartite crowns is resolved beyond its optimum: both all-set and minimal-set enumerators, sharp upper-minimal invariant, three-point cardinality spectrum with unbounded gaps, and a dual packing value are proved. These are not generic consequences of geodesic transversal definitions or the known K_n,n minimum; the precise invariant guides monitoring and minimal hitting-set enumeration.
